supported_sdk.identity: Both sdkRegistrationCompiler identities equal the original full-recipe registrationCompiler; the supported SDK recipe is unchanged.

native_suites.qualification: The runner build exports complete compiled core suites; it does not establish a test pass. Unmodified suites execute through the ordinary shell from a disposable full repository with its exact schema submodule. Types/API/core source and dependency recipes equal the frozen candidate; the final production-profile CLI qualification uses the immutable frozen revision.

runtime.qualification: Twenty warm alternating startup observations per command; both use the identical measured leaf edit. No build-speed acceptance is inferred.

worker_transfer.qualification: Independent local store seeded with the exact shared runtime closure. Missing outputs fail with builders and substituters disabled; copied original outputs then realise with matching NAR hashes and no compilation. Local transfer is not an internet-cache performance or cross-platform claim.

dotfiles.scope: Actual yujin package overlay, normal project pins with a read-only immutable source override; no activation.

combined_system.qualification: Actual yujin Darwin system graph contains exactly each producing CLI derivation under immutable source overrides; no activation or remote publication.

cost.allocation: The supported SDK is the unchanged full recipe: charge its complete fresh wrapper/import and interpreter checks, plus all frozen production-profile qualification and graph verification. The private executable-artifact library import is an extra research probe outside that supported SDK contract; retain its cost separately, including the all-probe eleven-edit quote. Ordinary first builds, complete existing family suites, source guards and system assembly occur in both workflows; no new seed/migration output, generation or recurring manual maintenance is introduced. Baseline/candidate native guards and local transfers are measured, and no saving credit is taken. Optional simultaneous SDK/executable builds incur additional build and retention cost.

recovered_commit_shell_side_effect.event: Existing default-shell hook initialized a new empty local development cluster during commit preparation. No server started and no existing cluster occupied that path.
recovered_commit_shell_side_effect.recovery: Moved only the newly initialized cluster outside the repository, retaining it without deletion.

limits: Native Apple Silicon evidence only; other platform defaults unchanged.
Independent local-store copy with per-command trust for locally built outputs is not hosted CI, internet transfer, cache publication or changed daemon trust.
No production service activation or existing database mutation; an empty cluster initialized by the commit shell was relocated without starting a server.
No remote Git or application-cache publication; actual immutable local producer overrides are verified.
All 92 compiler events remain: this reduces artifact-generation work, not source-module reuse.
